announcements.text: General Dynamics Land Systems Inc., Sterling Heights, Michigan, was awarded a $135,940,076 modification (P00005) to contract W912CH-25-D-0050 to establish the pricing for procurement of the complete Stryker Enhanced Power Distribution Unit Version 2 Retrofit Kit. This modification brings the total cumulative face value to $162,413,191. One bid was solicited with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Aug. 8, 2030. Army Contracting Command, Detroit Arsenal, Michigan, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Corp., Rotary and Mission Systems, Littleton, Colorado, was awarded an $88,560,319 cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for the Radiant Mercury program. This contract provides for the production, installation, program management, maintenance, modernization, and sustainment of Radiant Mercury General Service Cross Domain Solution systems. The effort also includes system security authorization support, logistics, and training services in support of Department of the Navy and other government requirements. Radiant Mercury enables the secure transfer of information across different security domains, supporting operational information-sharing requirements for the Department of Defense and other government agencies. The contract includes a three-year ordering period from Oct. 20, 2026, through Oct. 19, 2029. Specific requirements, places of performance, periods of performance, and funding will be established through individual task orders issued under the contract. The contract has a minimum ordering guarantee of $50,000 and a maximum ceiling value of $88,560,319. Individual task orders will be funded using applicable appropriations provided by the requesting government activities. This contract was not competitively procured pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1), as implemented by Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source. Naval Information Warfare Center Pacific, San Diego, California, is the contracting activity (N66001-27-D-0006).

announcements.text: Systems Planning and Analysis Inc., Alexandria, Virginia, is awarded a $36,835,008 cost-plus-fixed-fee term task order (N00030-27-F-3022) for support of the Trident II Strategic Weapons System. This value includes optional line items, if exercised. Tasks to be performed include technical studies and assessments, systems engineering and analysis support, and technical engineering services. Work will be performed in Alexandria, Virginia (85%); Washington, D.C. (13%); and Bangor, Washington (2%). Work is expected to be completed on Oct. 31, 2031. This action is awarded subject to the availability of funds in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul 52.232-18. This task order will be awarded as a sole source acquisition with the authority of 15 U.S. Code 638 Research and Development. Portfolio Acquisition Executive Strategic Systems Programs, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

extracted.description: Support for Trident II Strategic Weapons System: technical studies, systems engineering and analysis, technical engineering services
extracted.competition: Sole source, 15 U.S.C. 638 Research and Development authority

announcements.text: Tarrant County Association for the Blind, Fort Worth, Texas, has been awarded a maximum $24,583,698 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-quantity contract for aerial delivery dissipating pads. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(5), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.103-5. This is a five-year contract with no option periods. The performance completion date is Oct. 25, 2031. Using military services are Air Force, Army, Navy, and Marine Corps. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 through 2032 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support, Richmond, Virginia (SPE4A7-27-D-0029).
